title: Explicit semantic robot-budget execution must fail closed, never realize lexical
description: Narrow startable ds7uy.4 source slice independent of the blocked immutable-generation classifier. Current search setup in src/lib.rs groups requested Semantic and Hybrid when RobotBudget is NearLimit or Exhausted and calls SearchModeMeta::fall_back_to_lexical. This violates the explicit-mode contract and can return lexical results for an explicit semantic request. Preserve Hybrid fail-open. For explicit Semantic, budget pressure must never mutate realized mode to Lexical: NearLimit may continue semantic work within the deadline; Exhausted returns the existing bounded timed-out or partial semantic envelope, or a typed strict budget error, but never lexical evidence. Keep requested and realized mode truthful through all result paths. Scope is only budget policy and its direct tests; do not implement or duplicate ds7uy.1 manifest resolution, ds7uy.3 reader topology, or the full RecoveryPlan classifier. Acceptance: pure unit tests cover Healthy, NearLimit, Exhausted for Semantic, Hybrid and Lexical; explicit Semantic never calls lexical fallback; Hybrid still records lexical fallback reason when shedding semantic; a fresh-process CLI E2E builds usable semantic assets, invokes search --mode semantic --json --timeout 1, and proves no successful or partial payload claims realized lexical and no lexical hits are substituted; exhausted output is bounded and machine-readable; focused regression for default Hybrid remains green; logs stay below 10k lines and 8 MiB with no raw query/path TRACE; cargo fmt, focused tests, workspace check/clippy/all-target validation, and UBS pass. The test must be RED against the pre-fix parent and GREEN after the fix.

dependencies.title: One semantic readiness and RecoveryPlan state machine across all truth surfaces
